svg.title: Causal linear recurrence over sequence steps
svg.desc: A timeline of sequence steps where step t reads only steps up to t. Per step, the outer product of key k and value v accumulates into a running state, and the output is the query q dotted with that state. The state stays on chip inside one fused kernel.
svg.text: Causal linear recurrence: a running summary of the past
causal — step t reads only steps s ≤ t

g.text: outer product of key and value

svg.text: written as map → cumsum → contract over plain tensors — the compiler fuses it into one CUDA kernel
